name: Thailand
shortSummary: India and Thailand share deep Buddhist and cultural ties, formalized cooperation through the Act East Policy, and are jointly developing the India-Myanmar-Thailand Trilateral Highway to boost overland connectivity.

majorAreasOfCooperation.description: Shared Buddhist heritage anchors tourism and cultural exchange.
Joint infrastructure development under the Act East Policy.

majorChallenges.title: Trilateral Highway delays
majorChallenges.description: Construction of the connectivity corridor through Myanmar has been repeatedly delayed by security conditions there.

recentDevelopments.title: Trilateral Highway construction continues amid delays
recentDevelopments.description: Work on the India-Myanmar-Thailand Trilateral Highway continued, though security conditions in Myanmar kept the project behind schedule.
recentDevelopments.whyItMatters: A key regional connectivity ambition remains only partly realized, limiting the pace of deeper integration.

historicalEvents.title: Free Trade Framework Agreement
historicalEvents.description: India and Thailand sign an early-harvest trade liberalisation framework, a precursor to broader ASEAN engagement.

historicalEvents.title: Strategic Partnership
historicalEvents.description: India and Thailand elevate ties to a Strategic Partnership.

agreements.name: India-Myanmar-Thailand Trilateral Highway
agreements.description: Overland connectivity project linking India's northeast to Southeast Asia, still under phased completion.

defenceCooperation.description: Bilateral army exercise between India and Thailand.

multilateralRelations.detail: Engaged through India's Act East Policy.
